what: All three backbones (vggt, pi3, da3) re-evaluated at stride 60 -- the span ticket 10 identified as the paper's own protocol (vanilla reproduces Tab.2 on vggt and pi3 at this stride). Eval only: no new fits except DA3's (see s10-snpp-3f15a9266d-da3-raytun3r-9cb7410/, same session). vggt/pi3 adapters reused unchanged from runs/rt3r/3f15a9266d-{vggt,pi3}/adapter.pt (fit at results/rt3r/s10-snpp-3f15a9266d-{,pi3-}222d4a3/).
protocol: eval only: full sequence, stride 60, 100 windows, methods vanilla+center_ph+raytun3r, same adapters as the stride-10 rows
commands: python -m raytun3r.eval --backbone vggt --weights pretrained --dataset scannetpp --path <scannetpp>/3f15a9266d --adapter runs/rt3r/3f15a9266d-vggt/adapter.pt --stride 60 --device cuda:0 --methods vanilla,center_ph,raytun3r --out vggt-s60.json

python -m raytun3r.eval --backbone pi3 --weights pretrained --dataset scannetpp --path <scannetpp>/3f15a9266d --adapter runs/rt3r/3f15a9266d-pi3/adapter.pt --stride 60 --device cuda:0 --methods vanilla,center_ph,raytun3r --out pi3-s60.json

python -m raytun3r.eval --backbone da3 --variant small --weights pretrained --dataset scannetpp --path <scannetpp>/3f15a9266d --adapter runs/rt3r/3f15-da3-fit/adapter.pt --stride 60 --device cuda:0 --methods vanilla,center_ph,raytun3r --out da3-s60.json

read_vs_paper_tab2.note: DA3 has no per-scene paper row; only vggt/pi3 are compared against Tab.2's absolute numbers. Reading rule from #4: no tuning toward the targets.
read_vs_paper_tab2.finding: Vanilla lands in the same neighborhood as the paper at this span (ours ~18-26% high, not exact but far closer than any stride-10 cell). center_ph and raytun3r do NOT reproduce the paper's ordering: on vggt and pi3, center_ph (0.62/0.27 deg) is dramatically BETTER than raytun3r (5.46/4.53 deg) here -- the opposite of the paper's Tab.2 (raytun3r 0.93/0.78 beating center_ph 2.45/2.28). On DA3 (no paper comparison), raytun3r does beat both vanilla and center_ph, so the ordering flips backbone to backbone -- not a fixed method-quality ranking. Not tuned toward paper targets; reported as measured.
